endonym.gloss: roughly, the water that stays, as against the water that leaves twice a day

description.value: A wet, warm-tempered world on an orbit eccentric enough that the year divides into a long mild stretch and a short violent one. Its outsized moon drags a tidal range of twenty-six metres across the shallow northern shelf, so a fifth of the inhabited surface is sea for six hours and mud for six. Inland, the continents carry closed high-canopy forest with almost no understory, and the equatorial belt is under permanent convection. It is the best-surveyed world in the galaxy and the one the ethics committee writes to most often.
Vlažen svet z raztegnjeno orbito in plimskim razponom čez dvajset metrov. Kratko poletje je nasilno.

Um mundo húmido e temperado, numa órbita bastante excêntrica para que o ano se divida num longo período ameno e num curto período violento. A sua lua desmesurada arrasta uma amplitude de maré de vinte e seis metros pela plataforma norte, pouco profunda, de modo que um quinto da superfície habitada é mar durante seis horas e lodo durante outras seis. No interior, os continentes têm floresta fechada de dossel alto e quase sem sub-bosque, e a faixa equatorial está em convecção permanente. É o mundo mais bem estudado da galáxia e aquele para o qual a comissão de ética escreve com mais frequência.

atmosphere.value: Nitrogen with nineteen per cent oxygen and a heavy water load, 1.14 bar at sea level. Standing on the flats at low water is warm, extremely loud with wind, and smells strongly of iodine.

biosphere.value: Life is present: 3 catalogued species (Standing Wood Canopy Smallfolk, Storm Belt Ridge Dwellers, Tall Shoals Weir Builders) and 3 recorded non-sapient organisms. The survey is not claimed to be complete.
